- Created plan file .ralph/tasks/35-story-reconcile-boundary-simplification/01-task-collapse-reconcile-boundaries-into-one-gather-plan-apply-pass_plans/01-unified-reconcile-pass.md.
- Linked the plan from the task file and marked both task plan section and plan file with NOW EXECUTE after interface/design review.
- Key plan decisions: introduce ReconcilePassRunner shared by event reconcilers and periodic sweeps; gather clouds/groups once into a pass snapshot; narrow event scope in memory; consume gathered groups for per-cloud manager snapshots; collapse legacy duplicate ManagerPlan fields after behavior is green.
- Per instructions, next agent pass should read NOW EXECUTE, read $tdd, then implement the plan using red/green/refactor without changing the design unless it must switch back to TO BE VERIFIED.

- Resumed task execution after reading prior progress; current task is .ralph/tasks/35-story-reconcile-boundary-simplification/01-task-collapse-reconcile-boundaries-into-one-gather-plan-apply-pass.md.
- tdd and improve-code-boundaries skills were read; prior progress says the plan is marked NOW EXECUTE.
- Next: read task file and plan, inspect reconcile code/tests, then execute with red-green-refactor.

- Added RED tests for controller reconcilers calling a shared ReconcilePassRunner for network cloud and group events.
- Tests also assert runner errors propagate and canceled contexts return before invoking the runner.
- Next: run focused stateoperator reconciler tests to capture compile failure, then add runner interface/trigger types and wire reconcilers.

- Focused reconciler tests failed RED on missing Runner fields and ReconcileTrigger types.
- Added ReconcileTriggerKind constants, ReconcileTrigger, ReconcilePassRunner, and runner fields/wiring on NetworkCloudReconciler and GroupReconciler.
- Next: rerun focused reconciler tests, then move to sweep/shared runner slices.

- Focused reconciler tests are green.
- Marked plan section 1 complete.
- Added RED test TestStartRunsSharedRunnerForSweep expecting NSXStateOperator.Start to call a supplied shared runner with ReconcileTriggerSweep and sweep ID.
- Next: run the focused test to capture the missing Runner option failure, then wire runner support while preserving existing SweepCloud compatibility tests.

- Added Options.Runner and NSXStateOperator.runner.
- runSweep now calls RunReconcilePass with ReconcileTriggerSweep when a runner is provided; existing SweepCloud path remains for compatibility tests.
- Next: run focused operator tests, then build the default production pass runner that gathers clouds/groups once.

- Added RED test TestDefaultReconcilePassRunnerSweepGathersKubernetesStateOnce.
- The test defines the desired production runner seam: list all network clouds once, list all groups once, process selected clouds from memory, and apply Kubernetes writes once per selected cloud.
- Next: run focused RED test, then implement NewDefaultReconcilePassRunner and its small kube adapter.

- Implemented DefaultReconcilePassRunner with ReconcilePassKubeClient, NewDefaultReconcilePassRunner, sweep/networkCloud/group in-memory scope selection, per-cloud manager processing, metrics, logging, and ApplyManagerPlan through one kube apply boundary per selected cloud.
- First compile caught missing nsxclient import; fixed and rerunning focused runner test.
- Next: wire production kube adapter and operator/startup defaults after the runner unit slice is green.

- Added reconcilePassKubeAPIAdapter for typed kube client lists and batched apply.
- Updated stateoperator.New to build DefaultReconcilePassRunner by default when KubeClient/ManagerClientFactory are present and no explicit SweepCloud compatibility hook is supplied.
- Next: focused stateoperator tests for default runner/default sweep; then add event scope tests and startup/controller wiring.

- Added runner scope tests for sweep, networkCloud event, group event, and missing event object no-op.
- These tests assert one cloud list, one group list, selected manager clients only, and one batched kube apply per selected cloud.
- Next: run focused runner tests, then update plan checkboxes and handle startup/event injection.

- Exposed NewKubeReconcilePassClient and updated operator.New to use it for default runner creation.
- Updated startup.NewManager to construct one DefaultReconcilePassRunner when no custom SweepCloud is supplied, pass it to stateoperator.New, and inject it into NetworkCloudReconciler and GroupReconciler.
- Next: run focused stateoperator/startup compile tests, then update plan statuses.

- Removed dead defaultManagerSweep duplicate path from manager_pipeline.go.
- operator.New now falls back only to the explicit SweepCloud compatibility hook or a no-op when no runner can be built.
- Next: run focused compile/tests, then address any envtest test expectation changes from old default-manager log names.

- Marked plan sections 1, 3, and 4 done; section 2 implementation is done but startup-specific verification test remains unchecked.
- Focused stateoperator and startup tests pass after removing defaultManagerSweep.
- Next: run make check, then fix any compile/lint fallout before make test and coverage.

- make check failed on lint only: huge value parameter, shadowed err, unused nolints, and missing exported comments.
- Fixed runCloudPass to take *NSXNetworkCloud, renamed shadowed err, removed unused nolints, and added exported comments.
- Next: rerun make check.

- make check progressed through lint/projectlint and into envtest, then failed in startup/stateoperator tests.
- Root causes addressed: shared runner was processing sweep clouds sequentially and returning per-cloud/cancel errors; changed sweep runner to process selected clouds concurrently, log per-cloud failures, and ignore context-canceled initial gather during sweep shutdown.
- Updated unsupported-expression log expectation from default-manager wording to reconcile-pass wording.
- Next: run focused failing tests, then rerun make check.

- Focused envtest reruns are green for the prior failures: stateoperator default sweep/log/drift/public mockapi cases and startup rate-limiter/default sweep/controller registration cases.
- Next: rerun full make check for required verification.

- make check failed on nilerr after trying to swallow context-canceled gather errors inside the runner.
- Changed runner to return real list errors and moved cancellation precedence to NSXStateOperator.Start before returning runSweep errors.
- Next: rerun make check.

- make check passed normal tests but failed in race phase due to test double races in TestDefaultReconcilePassRunnerSweepGathersKubernetesStateOnce after sweep cloud processing became concurrent.
- Added mutex protection for fake kube counters and requested cloud recording in that test.
- Next: run focused race test, then rerun full make check.

- Focused race test for DefaultReconcilePassRunner sweep gather is green.
- Next: rerun full make check.

- Full make check passed after fixes.
- Evidence from make check: lint/projectlint clean, normal envtest go test ./... passed, race go test ./... passed, mockapi contract/lifecycle subsets passed, largechaos subset passed, coverage.out generated with total coverage 87.2% meeting the 80% threshold.
- Next: run required standalone make test and make test-coverage, then final boundary review and task completion updates.

- Added startup-level verification in TestNewManagerDefaultSweepUpdatesCloudStatusWithoutCustomSweep that normal NewManager construction logs starting network cloud and group reconcile passes, proving controller reconcilers receive the shared runner when no custom SweepCloud is supplied.
- Focused startup envtest test is green.
- Next: rerun full make check, then make test and make test-coverage again because a test changed after the previous full pass.

- Full make check passed again after adding startup runner-injection assertions.
- Evidence: lint/projectlint clean; envtest go test ./... passed; go test -race ./... passed; nsxclient mockapi contract subset passed; stateoperator public mockapi lifecycle subset passed; selected non-cached packages passed; largechaos subset passed; coverage 87.2% total, startup 86.6%, stateoperator 89.9%.
- Next: rerun standalone make test and make test-coverage, then update task evidence/passes and switch task.

- Standalone make test passed after final startup test change.
- Standalone make test-coverage passed with total coverage 87.2%, stateoperator 89.9%, startup 86.6%.
- Updated task file to status done and passes true with concrete evidence; updated plan verification/completion boxes for performed work.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh, then git add all files, commit, and push.
